entry.author: AUT - Auckland University of Technology
entry.summary:
Feeling unsure about what to study after high school? AUT's UniPrep is designed for students spending their summer weighing up options, second-guessing themselves, or wondering if uni is really for them.

Get a taste of university life before semester starts. Learn the skills you'll actually use, meet new friends who'll be in your corner, and get a clearer idea of where you're headed. 

Your future doesn't need a perfect plan. It just needs a place to start. Learn more about UniPrep at AUT and how it can help you prepare for university life.

Find out more: https://www.aut.ac.nz/uniprep

Follow us on socials for more updates:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/UniPrepatAUT/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/autuniprep/
